ValidationRule.description: Code must match PRJ-YYYY-NNNN-XX, the year must be sane, and the suffix must equal the uppercased first two letters of the name.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT(ISBLANK(Code__c)), OR( NOT(REGEX(Code__c, 'PRJ-[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{4}-[A-Z]{2}')), IF( REGEX(Code__c, 'PRJ-[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{4}-[A-Z]{2}'), OR( VALUE(MID(Code__c, 5, 4)) < 2000, VALUE(MID(Code__c, 5, 4)) > YEAR(TODAY()) + 1, RIGHT(Code__c, 2) <> UPPER(LEFT(SUBSTITUTE(Name, ' ', ''), 2)) ), FALSE ) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Code must look like PRJ-YYYY-NNNN-XX with XX = first two letters of the name.
